name: Crouching Panda, Hidden Moose
storyline: Day and night, deafening howls, menacing roars and victorious bellows do not subside in the local Battle Arena! This is not the dreary fights of Homo Sapiens, where the opponents differ only in the color of boxer shorts - in the game "Crouching Panda, Hidden Moose" animals of different breeds and all possible colors find out whose fangs are sharper, hooves are stronger, and horns are more branchy. Join the celebration of natural selection and invite your friends to have a lot of fun together!
summary:
Do you want to try on the crown of the king of animals? Or maybe you want to become a master of kung fu? Anyway you`ll have a lot of fun with this awesome game!
Choose an animal (Crocodile, Panda, Rhino, or even the Skunk), give special abilities to it, arm it and send to the Arena to fight real opponents with great tricks and humor! Every battle is a funny colorful cartoon. Your animal can be a winner!
